parameters.name: CloudResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF in cloud native mode.

> You can call [CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~) to connect a resource and then view the resource ID in the response.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the cloud service connected to WAF.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud service instance.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: ResourceProduct
parameters.description: The type of the cloud service.
